issues.title: User name field label changed to 'Last name'
issues.description: The third field label reads 'Last name' in the actual implementation instead of 'User name' as shown in the baseline. This means the User name field is effectively missing and replaced with a duplicate Last name label, preventing the user from understanding where to enter their username.

issues.title: First name label missing space
issues.description: The first field label reads 'Firstname' (one word) in the actual implementation instead of 'First name' (two words) as shown in the baseline.

issues.title: Cancel button background color changed
issues.description: The Cancel button has a red/darker background color in the actual implementation, whereas in the baseline it has a lighter pinkish/grey background color.

issues.title: User name input field is missing
issues.description: Since the 'User name' label has been replaced with a duplicate 'Last name' label, there is no way for the user to identify and fill in the User name field, which is essential for creating a user account.
